## About
Lotus Automotive is a full-service auto repair and preventive maintenance center in the Greenwood Seattle area. We're qualified to repair and service all domestic and imported cars, using parts that are equal to or exceed the standards of the ones your car came with.
We're a cost-effective alternative to the dealership for scheduled maintenance on your personal or company car, pickup or truck. Regardless of where it was built, we'll service it and still maintain the manufacturer's warranty.
When you call or come by, you'll talk with Zoltan Balogh. One reviewer put it simply: "Zoltan and Spencer are great." We hold a 4.9 rating from 54 Google reviews.

## Services
- Computer diagnosis: Free computer diagnosis to find out what's going on before any work starts. (Free)
- Timing Belts and Chains: Timing belt and timing chain replacement.
- Electrical and Electronics: Diagnosis and repair of your car's electrical and electronic systems.
- Automatic Transmissions: Automatic transmission service and repair.
- Minor and Major Engine Repairs: Engine work, from small fixes to bigger jobs.

## FAQ
Q: What makes of cars do you work on?
A: German, Japanese and domestic cars, including Mercedes, Audi, Acura, VW, BMW, Honda, Toyota, Volvo, Porsche, Lexus, Ford, Jeep and more.

Q: Will servicing my car here affect my warranty?
A: No. Regardless of where your car was built, we'll service it and still maintain the manufacturer's warranty.

Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: One reviewer said Zoltan doesn't mind working with your own parts. Give us a call and we'll talk it through.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us or send a message through the contact form with your name, email, phone number and what's going on with your car.
